scenarios.name: authentication
scenarios.description: No rule denies; bad, revoked, rotated and outdated credentials fail before any rule is read.

scenarios.name: idempotency
scenarios.description: A request_id replays its stored result, rejects other input, and never outranks a deny.

scenarios.name: proposals
scenarios.description: Ask stores a proposal without writing; the owner accepts, modifies or rejects it once.

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.description: A proposal is applied only on the state it saw; conditional writes check the base under the write lock.

scenarios.name: revocation
scenarios.description: Permissions are re-read on every request, on acceptance and on reading an answered proposal.

scenarios.name: conditions
scenarios.description: Amount and account limits fall back to ask or deny; actions without that field reject the rule.

scenarios.name: offline-and-async
scenarios.description: Delivered envelopes never apply by themselves; asynchronous backups never wait for approval.

scenarios.name: restoration
scenarios.description: Restoring a copy restores the connections, rules and revocations stored in it.
